security.title: Security & Compliance
security.subtitle: Your data security matters. Learn how VetImage protects your clinic and pet-owner data — and how our AI is meant to be used.
security.hipaaCompliantDesc: Encryption, access control, and audit logging for your clinic and owner data.
security.questionsDesc: Our security team is available to answer any questions about our security practices, certifications, or to provide documentation for compliance reviews.

features.encryptionDesc: All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 encryption.
features.hipaaDesc: Owner personal data is handled following GDPR principles. Veterinary imaging is not subject to HIPAA (which covers human health data only).
features.authDesc: Multi-layered security with JWT tokens and API keys with granular permissions.
features.isolationDesc: Complete data segregation between users and organizations.
features.auditLoggingDesc: Comprehensive logging of all system activities and data access.
features.infrastructureDesc: Enterprise-grade infrastructure with redundancy and monitoring.

disclosure.title: Responsible Disclosure
disclosure.description: We take security seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it to us responsibly.
disclosure.reward: Eligible researchers may receive acknowledgment and rewards through our bug bounty program.

security.aiDesc: VetImage AI is clinical decision support — not a diagnosis. Every AI result is a draft for a qualified veterinarian to review and approve. AI may miss findings; it never replaces professional judgement.
security.notDevice: Not a medical device. Not FDA-cleared. For veterinary decision support and research only.

features.title: Everything your clinic needs, in one platform
features.subtitle: From upload to AI-assisted read to a report the owner can understand — VetImage covers the whole veterinary imaging workflow.

capabilities.analysisDesc: Upload a study, get a model recommendation, and dispatch decision-support analysis in a few clicks — every result stays a draft for a vet to review.
capabilities.viewerDesc: Browse studies and open a full Cornerstone/OHIF-based viewer with AI findings overlaid directly on the image.
capabilities.patientsDesc: Owners, animals, visits, vaccinations, weight trends, appointments, prescriptions, allergies, and lab results in one record.
capabilities.reportsDesc: Vet-approved reports export to PDF, share with owners via a plain-language portal, or hand off to a referral specialist.
capabilities.monitoringDesc: A live worklist and audit log keep track of every analysis task and who touched what, with WebSocket updates as things happen.
capabilities.multiClinicDesc: Organization-scoped data isolation with English, Spanish, and Portuguese support built in.

features.toolsSubtitle: Standalone utilities for working with DICOM data beyond the analysis workflow.

tools.viewerDesc: Browse uploaded studies and open the full-screen medical image viewer.
tools.anonymizerDesc: Remove owner and patient identifying information from DICOM files before sharing or research use.
tools.converterDesc: Convert DICOM files to NIfTI, JPEG, or PNG for use outside the platform.
tools.tagEditorDesc: Review and correct DICOM metadata tags — patient name, ID, accession number — on a study or a single instance.
tools.sharingDesc: Token-gated links let owners view a shared report or a specialist review a referral package, no login required.

features.ctaTitle: Ready to see it on your own studies?
features.ctaDesc: Create a free account and upload your first study in minutes.

aiDisclaimer.short: Decision support — not a diagnosis. A qualified veterinarian must review and approve all AI results. AI may miss findings.
